name: doorbell
description: Sound and a clickable macOS banner when a Claude Code session in VS Code needs you or has finished. The click lands in the right window and the right chat.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the banner text: en or cs.

min_done_seconds.title: Shortest turn worth announcing (seconds)
min_done_seconds.description: A turn that finishes faster than this ends while you are still watching it, so it stays silent. 0 announces every turn.

sound_attention.title: Sound: needs you
sound_attention.description: Played when a session waits for your approval or answer. A name from /System/Library/Sounds, without the extension.

sound_done.title: Sound: finished
sound_done.description: Played when a session has finished its turn. A name from /System/Library/Sounds, without the extension.

sound_error.title: Sound: error
sound_error.description: Played when a turn was stopped by an API error. A name from /System/Library/Sounds, without the extension.

speak.title: Say the project name
speak.description: After the sound, a voice says which project is calling, so you can tell windows apart without looking.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: A voice from `say -v '?'`. Empty uses the system voice (Zuzana when the language is cs).

mute.title: Mute
mute.description: No sound and no banner. Events are still written to the log.
